module Probe
 module File
  def self.dirname(path); yield; "unchanged"; end
  def self.expand_path(path); path; end
 end
 seen = []
 value = File.expand_path(File.dirname(__FILE__) { seen << :called })
 p [value, seen]
end

module Probe
 module ERB
  def self.new(*args, **kwargs, &block)
   [args, kwargs, block ? block.call : nil]
  end
 end
 options = {eoutvar: "buffer"}
 p ERB.new("source", nil, "-", **options)
end

expected.message: Passing safe_level with the 2nd argument of `ERB.new` is deprecated. Do not use it, and specify other arguments as keyword arguments.
Passing trim_mode with the 3rd argument of `ERB.new` is deprecated. Use keyword argument like `ERB.new(str, trim_mode: "-")` instead.
